scope: FlexGS learns budget-conditioned selection and geometric transforms; NanoGS simplifies through training-free local merging and parameter recomputation. Reported time trade-offs refer to our experiments; NanoGS conversion to an unprepared target is distinct from switching among cached models. Quality claims refer only to five measured budgets and 13-scene mean metrics in shared-Full Table 2.
